objective: Prove: (1) a doubling lemma: a knot on Z + {t, t'} with Z nonempty that allows t' = t at every value of Z fails elimination once two copies share t and t'; (2) in a law composing like cycles no circuit overlaps, so every circuit's top image is a Latin hypercube (the Latin conjecture of KNOT-IMAGES-20261021-001B-P001), and a law composes like cycles exactly when proper pp-definable equivalences on the ranges make every circuit functional; (3) Thomsen's configuration in the 3-net law of a Latin square is the full relation or an overlapping knot, the latter exactly when Thomsen's closure condition fails, so the 3-net law composes like cycles exactly for isotopes of abelian p-groups; (4) for Q8 the configuration is the commuting-differences relation, whose top image is not affine, and an explicit system of two copies fails elimination, so the 3-net of Q8 does not compose like cycles and Conjecture 7 of CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001 survives.
status: Proved by THOMSEN-KNOTS-20261021-001A-P001 (V1 prose proof with exhaustive and randomized checks; Thomsen's closure theorem, Theorems 1 and 4 of KNOT-IMAGES-20261021-001B-P001 and Lemma 2 of MALTSEV-CONVERSE-20261020-001B-P001 cited). The 3-net law of Q8 does not compose like cycles: Thomsen's configuration T (for groups, x2^-1 x1 and x3^-1 x1 commute) is a knot that allows x2 = x1, and T(x1, x2, x3) & T(x1, x2, x3') violates elimination; its top image omega(c1 + c2, c1 + c3) = 0 is the non-affine relation behind the 416-equation certificate. In general no circuit of a law composing like cycles overlaps: two copies of an overlapping knot contain, by elimination, a circuit relation with a selector, and two copies of that fail. So the Latin conjecture holds, and a law composes like cycles exactly when its circuits are Latin hypercubes modulo the tops. A Latin square's 3-net law composes like cycles exactly when the square is isotopic to an abelian p-group; every non-abelian group fails. Conjecture 7 of CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001 survives and is open.
title: Proof: no knot overlaps; Q8 and the 3-nets
